column1: # Set-mode EPathMap subtraction: whole-map PathMap::subtract versus root-focused WriteZipper::subtract_into.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned.
# Preflight: 81.53% aggregate idle; CPU 8 was 98.33% idle; 50 GiB available memory; zero swap used.

# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 /usr/bin/time -v cargo bench -j4 -p models --bench epathmap_set_subtract_into --features epathmap-subtract-into-differential
# Design: 60 retained paired/interleaved samples after 10 warmups per cell; arm order rotated each repetition; exactly one run.

# Fixture: 2,048 nominal entries; disjoint roots, identical sets, half overlap, singleton right, sparse right, 128-byte shared prefix, identical value-free topology, and partially overlapping value-free topology.
# Correctness: exact EntryTrie and EPM1 equality plus left/right operand non-mutation asserted before timing.
# Result: REJECTED by pgmcp experiment/hypothesis 256. Welch t=0.3777963814, p=0.6471672085, Cohen's d=0.0243866516, 95% CI [-37711.3020,55692.8270] ns.
# Robustness: Cliff's delta=0.1246354167; Mann-Whitney p=0.0008303684. Both arms are non-normal; the robust test detects the value-bearing treatment-slower shift.

# Decision: retain whole-map PathMap::subtract. Treatment supplies no supported advantage, is slower in every value-bearing cell, and five value-bearing paired 99% intervals exclude zero in the regressing direction.
# Resources: 106,340 KiB peak RSS; 0.87 s wall time; 8,192 MiB MemoryMax; zero swap.
# Pgmcp control run 15375282-61bb-4547-a8ce-a1e52882bb15; treatment run a2dca500-1b27-45a0-b9d2-781c13d03461; artifact 335.
